_meta.description: Every element of the inland (Gauteng) price per litre, as the DMPR lists it each month.
_meta.publisher: Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources (DMPR)
_meta.document: Petrol Margins and Diesel Margins tables, November 2026 fuel price pack
_meta.units: South African cents per litre, exactly as printed
_meta.covers: Petrol 95, diesel 0.05% sulphur and diesel 0.005% sulphur, inland. The DMPR tables give no breakdown for petrol 93, illuminating paraffin or coastal prices.
_meta.dmpr_label: The DMPR titles these tables "Petrol Margins are only Guidelines" and "Diesel Margins are only Guidelines".
_meta.rounding: Petrol pump prices are rounded to whole cents, so the elements can differ from the price by a fraction of a cent.
